import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv
#check_failure Roth.normOne_monomial
namespace MonomialNormRaw
open MvPolynomial
variable {σ : Type*}
noncomputable def replacement (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) : ℝ := P.coeff.sum (fun _ z ↦ |(z : ℝ)|)
theorem direct (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : ℤ) : replacement (monomial e c) = |(c : ℝ)| :=
  MvPolynomial.sum_monomial_eq (u := e) (r := c) (b := fun _ (z : ℤ) ↦ |(z : ℝ)|)
    (show |((0 : ℤ) : ℝ)| = 0 from (congrArg abs Int.cast_zero).trans abs_zero)
theorem generic {ι R A : Type*} [Zero R] [AddCommMonoid A]
    (i : ι) (r : R) (size : ι → R → A) (hzero : size i 0 = 0) :
    (Finsupp.single i r).sum size = size i r := Finsupp.sum_single_index hzero
theorem genericPolynomial {R A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid A]
    (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R) (size : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A) (hzero : size e 0 = 0) :
    (monomial e c).coeff.sum size = size e c := MvPolynomial.sum_monomial_eq hzero
theorem zeroNecessary :
    (Finsupp.single () (0 : ℤ)).sum (fun _ _ ↦ (1 : ℕ)) ≠ 1 := by simp
#print axioms direct
#print axioms generic
#print axioms genericPolynomial
#print axioms zeroNecessary
#check @MvPolynomial.sum_monomial_eq
#check @Finsupp.sum_single_index
end MonomialNormRaw
